tokyo.summary: Around Kyobashi and Nihombashi there are still ordinary hotel rooms for 20–24 Dec within our budget, but the apartment hotels near Tokyo Station are almost full and cost ¥185,000–230,000 a night for one flat. The bigger rooms go first: Ryumeikan's 31–38 m² twins and doubles, the Metropolitan Marunouchi and most MIMARU units showed no rooms on Rakuten on 23 Oct. Best bet: Daiwa Roynet Kyobashi PREMIER (21–23 m² rooms, about ¥138,000–150,000 a night for our four rooms, free cancellation until two days before). Email Ryumeikan at the same time in case twins open up.

enquiry.en:
Subject: Room enquiry, 20–24 December 2026, 7 adults

Dear [PLACE] reservations team,

We are a family group of 7 adults (three couples and one single traveller) and would like to stay with you for 4 nights, checking in on Sunday 20 December and checking out on Thursday 24 December 2026.

We are looking for 3 double or twin rooms and 1 single room, ideally on the same floor or connecting. Could you please tell us:

1. Which room types are available for these dates, their size (m²) and bed sizes, and the total price for the stay?
2. One of us will be about 30 weeks pregnant. Could her room be a quiet one, with a bathtub, close to the lift?
3. We arrive from Haneda by private van, probably around midday. Can the van drop us at the entrance, and can you hold our bags until check-in?
4. On 23 December, can the front desk send 3–4 large suitcases by courier (takkyubin) to our hotel in Kyoto, for delivery on 30 December (or the latest date possible)? Roughly what would it cost?
5. What is your cancellation policy for this booking?

Thank you very much. We look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards,
Pedro [surname]
(Party of 7: Pedro & Fernanda, João & Carolina, Carlos & Nadir, Tatiana)
enquiry.ja:
件名：2026年12月20日〜24日 大人7名 宿泊のお問い合わせ

[PLACE] ご予約ご担当者様

突然のご連絡失礼いたします。
2026年12月20日（日）から24日（木）まで4泊、大人7名（夫婦3組と1名）で貴館への宿泊を検討しております。

ダブルまたはツインを3室、シングルを1室、できれば同じフロアか隣り合ったお部屋（コネクティングルーム）でお願いしたく存じます。つきましては、以下の点についてお教えいただけますでしょうか。

1. 上記日程で空いているお部屋のタイプ、広さ（㎡）とベッドのサイズ、4泊分の合計料金
2. 同行者の1名がその頃妊娠30週前後になります。静かで、浴槽があり、エレベーターに近いお部屋をご用意いただくことは可能でしょうか。
3. 羽田空港から貸切のワゴン車で、昼頃に到着する予定です。車をホテルの入口に着けることはできますか。また、チェックインまで荷物をお預かりいただけますか。
4. 12月23日に、大型スーツケース3〜4個をフロントから京都のホテルへ宅配便で送ることは可能でしょうか。お届け日は12月30日（または指定できる最も遅い日）を希望しております。おおよその料金もお教えいただけますと幸いです。
5. 本予約のキャンセル規定

お手数をおかけしますが、ご回答いただけますと幸いです。
何卒よろしくお願い申し上げます。

Pedro [姓]
（7名：Pedro・Fernanda、João・Carolina、Carlos・Nadir、Tatiana）

yudanaka.summary: Shibu Onsen itself is sold out for our dates: Sakaeya, Kokuya and the other Shibu inns show no rooms on 24–26 Dec on their own booking calendars and on Rakuten, and Shibu Hotel only has 25 Dec. Saturday 26 Dec is the hard night. Almost every inn in Yudanaka and Shibu is full that night. The best bet is a modern ryokan in Yudanaka with a lift and twin-bed rooms (Biyunoyado or Yorozuya, both a few minutes from the station) for 24–25 Dec, booked directly now. Then either join waiting lists for 26 Dec or spend that one night in a Nagano city hotel, which is on the way out anyway.

candidates.name: Issa no Komichi Biyunoyado (一茶のこみち 美湯の宿)
candidates.area: Yudanaka Onsen, about 7 min walk from Yudanaka station, on a hillside; Shibu's lantern lane is a short bus or taxi ride away
candidates.rooms_for_us: 44 rooms. Best mix: 1 Western room with its own open-air onsen ('Issa' or 'Sakura', for 2) + 2 Japanese-Western rooms (twin beds + 8-mat tatami room, 2–4 people; only one per floor, so the couples would be on different floors) + a tatami room for Tatiana
candidates.beds: Twin beds in the 4 Japanese-Western rooms and the 2 Western open-air-bath rooms; futons in the tatami rooms
candidates.lift: yes: rooms are on floors 4–7 of an 8-storey building, and booking sites list a lift (confirm it reaches every room floor)
candidates.private_bath: Every room has its own bath and toilet. Two Western rooms have a private open-air onsen, and there are two bookable rooftop private open-air baths
candidates.for_fernanda: Good fit: a bed, a lift, her own onsen tub and a short walk or free pickup from the station. Ask for the 'Issa' or 'Sakura' room for her and Pedro.
candidates.new_year: No Christmas Eve menu is shown. Dinner is the inn's seasonal Shinshu kaiseki (Shinshu premium beef plans). Check-in 15:00–18:00, check-out 10:00. Free pickup from Yudanaka station if you book it; call when leaving Nagano.
candidates.price: Rakuten on 23 Oct 2026, per room for 2 adults, dinner + breakfast, tax included. 24 Dec: Japanese-Western room ¥59,400 (1 left); open-air-bath room ¥92,600 (1 left). 25 Dec: 10-mat tatami ¥47,600; 'Sakura' Western open-air-bath room ¥118,800. 26 Dec: nothing on Rakuten. Official site 'from ¥16,500 per person' on its standard plan (not for our dates).
candidates.cancellation: not stated
candidates.why: On our list already, and it holds up: the strongest Yudanaka option for beds, lift and private baths.
candidates.watch_out: Sold out on Rakuten for 26 Dec, and only single rooms of each type are left for 24–25. Guests here do NOT get the Shibu nine-bath key.

candidates.name: Yudanaka Onsen Yorozuya (よろづや)
candidates.area: Yudanaka Onsen, about 7 min walk (2 min by taxi) from Yudanaka station; Shibu's lane is a short taxi ride away
candidates.rooms_for_us: 28 rooms. Ask for 2–3 'twin bed + 8-mat tatami' rooms in the main building (renovated 2026) for the couples, plus a tatami room for Tatiana
candidates.beds: Twin-bed rooms (twin bedroom + 8-mat tatami room) in the main building; other rooms are tatami with futons
candidates.lift: Main building (8 storeys, concrete) has a lift. The old wooden Shoraiso wing has no lift, so ask not to be put there
candidates.private_bath: Bookable private 'Private SPA Bon' (paid, with two saunas and a private bath). Whether the bed rooms have their own bath is not stated, so ask
candidates.for_fernanda: Twin-bed rooms in the lift building are wheelchair-friendly according to the inn's own barrier-free sheet. She should skip the sauna and use only the bath part of the private spa.
candidates.new_year: No Christmas menu shown. Seasonal kaiseki dinner 17:45–19:30, in a dining room or a private room. Check-in 15:00 (last 18:30), check-out 10:00. Pickup from Yudanaka station 14:30–18:30, timed to the express trains.
candidates.price: Rakuten on 23 Oct 2026, per room for 2 adults with dinner + breakfast. 24 Dec: Japanese rooms ¥68,000–80,000 (1 of each left). 25 Dec: ¥68,000–74,000 (3 left). 26 Dec: sold out. Bed rooms were not offered on Rakuten; check the official site.
candidates.cancellation: not stated (cancel online through the official booking page)
candidates.why: A famous old inn with the Momoyama bath, a listed cultural property. Its own booking calendar showed rooms on 24 and 25 Dec.
candidates.watch_out: Official calendar full on 26 Dec. The atmospheric Shoraiso wing has stairs only. No Shibu nine-bath key.

candidates.name: Shibu Onsen Shunran no Yado Sakaeya (春蘭の宿 さかえや)
candidates.area: At the Shibu Onsen end of the lantern lane; 7 min by bus or taxi from Yudanaka station
candidates.rooms_for_us: 23 rooms. Ideal set: 'Yoimachi Suite' (bed + private open-air onsen, 2–4) + 'Semi-suite Yu' (bed + view bath, 2) + 'Toki no Kura' or 'Shinano Modern' (low beds, 2) + a tatami room for Tatiana

candidates.lift: yes; a barrier-free room is listed too
candidates.private_bath: In-room onsen in the two suites. Bookable private onsen with sauna (¥7,000 for 2). Toki no Kura and Shinano Modern have a toilet but no bath
candidates.for_fernanda: The best Shibu fit on paper: lift, a bed and her own onsen in the Semi-suite or Yoimachi Suite. But it is full for our dates.
candidates.new_year: No Christmas menu shown. Creative kaiseki ('Kaiseki Komachi'). Check-in 15:00, check-out up to 12:00 (after 10:00 costs ¥3,300 an hour). Pickup by booking at 14:40, 16:20 and 17:40; the 15:00 slot is by public bus.
candidates.price: 24–26 Dec: sold out on the official calendar and on Rakuten (23 Oct 2026). For comparison, a November weekday showed ¥61,600–79,200 per room for 2 with dinner + breakfast.
candidates.cancellation: Free until 8 days before; 7–4 days 30%, 3–2 days 50%, day before 80%, same day or no-show 100%
candidates.why: The best-equipped inn in Shibu itself, and guests get the nine-bath key. Worth a waiting list request.

enquiry.en:
Dear [PLACE],

We are a family group of 7 adults (3 couples and 1 single) hoping to stay with you for 3 nights, checking in on Thursday 24 December 2026 and checking out on Sunday 27 December 2026, with dinner and breakfast. We would like 4 rooms (or 2–3 larger rooms). We will arrive by train at Yudanaka station in mid-afternoon on 24 December.

Could you please tell us:
1. Do you have rooms with Western beds (or Japanese-Western rooms with beds) for at least 2 of the couples? One of us will be about 30 weeks pregnant, and two of us are older and find futons and steep stairs difficult.
2. Is there a lift, or ground-floor rooms, so we can avoid stairs?
3. Do any rooms have their own bath, or is there a private family bath we can book? Can the water be cooled a little?
4. If you are full on any of the three nights (especially Saturday 26 December), can we join a waiting list for cancellations?
5. Is there a special dinner on Christmas Eve, or your usual winter menu? We can let you know about allergies.
6. Do you offer pickup from Yudanaka station, and at what times?
7. What are your cancellation fees?

We will book only through your official website or by email or phone with you. Thank you very much for your help.

Kind regards,
Pedro
enquiry.ja:
[PLACE] ご担当者様

突然のご連絡失礼いたします。2026年12月24日（木）チェックイン、12月27日（日）チェックアウトの3泊、1泊2食付きでの宿泊を検討しております。大人7名（夫婦3組と1名）の家族旅行で、4部屋（または広めのお部屋2〜3室）を希望しております。24日は午後の電車で湯田中駅に到着予定です。

以下の点についてお教えいただけますでしょうか。
1. 少なくとも2組分、ベッドのある洋室または和洋室はございますか。1名が妊娠約30週になり、また高齢の両親が布団や急な階段を苦手としております。
2. エレベーター、または1階のお部屋はございますか。
3. 客室風呂付きのお部屋、または予約制の貸切風呂（家族風呂）はございますか。お湯をぬるめにすることは可能でしょうか。
4. 満室の日（特に12月26日（土））がある場合、キャンセル待ちをお願いできますでしょうか。
5. 12月24日の夕食はクリスマス向けの献立がございますか、それとも冬の通常の献立でしょうか。アレルギーは別途お知らせいたします。
6. 湯田中駅からの送迎はございますか。時間帯もお教えください。
7. キャンセル料の規定をお教えください。

予約は貴館の公式サイト、またはメール・お電話で直接させていただく予定です。お手数をおかけいたしますが、どうぞよろしくお願い申し上げます。

ペドロ

notes.title: The Shibu bath key
notes.text: Only guests of Shibu Onsen inns get the key to the nine public baths (Shibu Hotel confirms its guests get it free, 06:00–22:00, and Sakaeya's plans say the same). Yudanaka and Kanbayashi inns don't include it. The Shibu baths are small, very hot and have no showers, which is fine for the others but not ideal for Fernanda.

notes.title: Getting to the snow monkeys
notes.text: In winter the only way in is from Kanbayashi: 15 min by bus from Yudanaka, then a 35-minute walk (about 1.6 km) on an unpaved, often icy forest path. The park says no wheelchairs or carts can get through, and it recommends snow boots and simple crampons, so buy spikes before going. Winter hours are 9:00–16:00. Online tickets started in Aug 2026, and from December to April online ticket holders get priority entry. Fees were revised on 20 Sep 2026, but the amount is shown only in an image. Year-end and weekends are very crowded: the park reported a queue of about 200 m last winter and may limit entry. For Fernanda at 29–32 weeks, the walk is the risk.

notes.title: This winter
notes.text: Shibu Onsen's main street is being repaved, with no cars allowed from 29 Jun to the end of Nov or early Dec 2026, so it should be finished by 24 Dec (check). The Temairazu booking system used by many ryokan, Kanaguya included, was hacked. Anyone who booked by 21 Sep 2026 may get convincing fake 'confirm your booking' emails or WhatsApp messages: never pay or give card details through a link, and book only through official channels. Nagano's new lodging tax adds ¥300 per person per night, plus ¥150 bathing tax.

notes.title: Places we left off
notes.text: Kanaguya was dropped. It has 29 tatami rooms with futons only and no beds, and the inn itself says there are a great many stairs and steps. It doesn't work for Fernanda or Carlos and Nadir. Ichinoyu Katei and the small family inns on the lane were also dropped (tatami and futons only, no confirmed lift).

kanazawa.summary: The best fits are three licensed machiya houses with a washer-dryer and real beds: Kuraha near the station (opened July 2026, two ground-floor bedrooms), Suiki 5 min from Omicho (a ground-floor room with two double beds) and Itose (a ground-floor queen bed). Their prices only show in a live calendar, so check them first. For a hotel, Resol Trinity right at Omicho (coin laundry, about ¥66k a night for 4 twins) and Tokyu Stay (a washer-dryer in every room, about ¥99k a night) are the best value. so, KANAZAWA is already fully booked, and twin, triple and family rooms are selling out everywhere. From our earlier list: Ainotsuji (max 6), Hanatsume (max 6) and Machiya Kenroku (sleeps 6) can't take 7 and are dropped; Dormy Inn and Hyatt House hold up but are over budget.

enquiry.en:
Dear [PLACE],

We are a family group of 7 adults (three couples and one single traveller) hoping to stay with you from 27 December 2026 to 30 December 2026 (3 nights). We arrive in Kanazawa by shinkansen around midday on the 27th, and we will be travelling with cabin bags only. One of us will be about 30 weeks pregnant, and two of us are older, so could you please help us with these questions:

1. Can all seven of us sleep in Western-style beds? If not, how many beds are there, and on which floors?
2. Is there a lift, or a bedroom with beds on the ground floor, close to a bathroom?
3. Is there a private bathroom or bath in each room, or which bathroom would the ground-floor bedroom use?
4. Is every bedroom heated?
5. Is there a washing machine and dryer we can use?
6. Are there any year-end closures or changes (front desk, cleaning, breakfast) between 27 and 30 December?
7. Can we leave our bags when we arrive around midday, before check-in?
8. What is the total price for 7 adults for the 3 nights, and what is your cancellation policy?

Thank you very much for your help. We look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards,
Pedro
enquiry.ja:

kyoto.summary: Kyoto over New Year is filling fast. On 23 Oct the big hotels by Gion (Granbell, the Celestine) and the Granvia at the station were already full for 30 Dec – 5 Jan, and what is left costs 2–6 times the usual rate. Few licensed houses near Gion have real beds for seven. The best bet is RESI STAY GION, a whole house by Keihan Sanjo with five big beds, ground-floor queens and two baths, if it is free. Next come two 2-bedroom apartments at MIMARU Kawaramachi Gojo, with Hotel Resol Trinity as the safe fallback (four twins at about ¥137,000 a night, still bookable). Kyoto's lodging tax since 1 Mar 2026 is per person per night, set by what each person pays: ¥200 under ¥6,000, ¥400 for ¥6,000–19,999, ¥1,000 for ¥20,000–49,999, ¥4,000 for ¥50,000–99,999 and ¥10,000 from ¥100,000. It is paid on top, often in cash. At New Year prices expect ¥1,000 each per night, about ¥42,000 for the seven over six nights.

candidates.name: RESI STAY GION (whole house)
candidates.area: 191 Shingoken-cho, Higashiyama, on the flat streets at the Sanjo end of Gion. 1 min walk from Keihan Sanjo station. Yasaka Shrine is about 1.3 km away, a 15–20 min flat walk (an estimate).
candidates.rooms_for_us: Whole two-floor house (146 m²), sleeps up to 9. Ground floor sleeps 4, upper floor sleeps 5. The page doesn't say how many separate bedrooms there are, so ask.
candidates.beds: All Western beds: 2 queens (160 cm) on the ground floor, plus 1 king (180 cm) and 2 queens upstairs. No futons needed.
candidates.lift: No lift (one listing says so). House on 2 floors with stairs, but there are beds on the ground floor.
candidates.private_bath: In the house: each floor has its own bathroom with a bath tub and its own toilet.
candidates.for_fernanda: The two ground-floor queen beds and the ground-floor bath mean Fernanda never needs the stairs. Ask whether the queens are in a room of their own.
candidates.new_year: Not stated. Check-in is at their counter near Kyoto Station, open 8:00–20:00; ask for its New Year hours.
candidates.price: Not shown. The house is priced per unit, not per person. Check the link.
candidates.cancellation: Not stated (the user policy is on their site). Ask.
candidates.licence: Ask. No licence number is shown on their pages. Make sure it is a Hotel/Ryokan Act (旅館業) licence: a house on a home-share notice in a residential street can only take guests from 15 Jan to 16 Mar.
candidates.why: The only house we found near Gion with real beds for all seven, ground-floor beds, two baths with tubs, two kitchens and two washer-dryers, which helps when restaurants close on 1–3 Jan.
candidates.watch_out: Check-in is at their counter in Kyoto Station's Higashishiokoji-cho, not at the house. Big cases can be sent to that counter by Yamato (label: name, dates, house name), and a free shuttle runs to the house 14:15–20:00. That suits a train arrival at Kyoto Station on 30 Dec. Bookings through Jalan are currently paused, so book direct.

candidates.name: MIMARU Kyoto Kawaramachi Gojo
candidates.area: On the west bank of the Kamo river at Gojo, just south-west of our area. 3 min walk from Keihan Kiyomizu-Gojo station, which is one stop from Gion-Shijo. Yasaka Shrine is about 25 min on foot (an estimate).
candidates.rooms_for_us: 2 × Two-Bedroom Apartment (60 m² each, 4 single beds in 2 bedrooms) gives 4 bedrooms and 8 beds. Another option is a Deluxe Apartment (6 single beds) plus an Apartment (5 single beds).
candidates.beds: Western single beds. Avoid the family and connecting types, which include bunk beds.
candidates.lift: Not stated on the page. It is a 96-room multi-storey hotel, so confirm.
candidates.private_bath: In every apartment: 1 bath, and 2 toilets in the two-bedroom types. There is also an accessible apartment with a universal-design bath, but it has a bunk bed.
candidates.for_fernanda: Beds, her own bedroom, an in-room bath and a one-stop train ride home from Gion-Shijo on the Keihan line, which runs all night on 31 Dec.
candidates.price: Not shown for our dates on the official site (its search returned nothing). The KNT listing gives a range of ¥9,900–¥100,800 per adult per night with no date breakdown. Check the link.
candidates.cancellation: Not stated. It is shown in their booking flow.
candidates.licence: Hotel (apartment hotel brand). No number shown.
candidates.why: Kitchen and dining table in every apartment, all in beds, 4 private bedrooms for the 3 couples and Tatiana, and an easy all-night train back from the Okera fire.
candidates.watch_out: The official page lists coin laundry rather than an in-room washer, although one third-party site says every room has one. Luggage is stored free 7:00–22:00 on check-in day; ask whether they will accept couriered cases arriving on 30 Dec.

candidates.name: Hotel Resol Trinity Kyoto
candidates.area: Fuyacho-dori Oike-agaru, north of downtown. 2 min walk from Kyoto-Shiyakusho-mae (Tozai subway line). Yasaka Shrine is about 25–30 min on foot, or a short taxi ride (an estimate). Outside our area.
candidates.rooms_for_us: 4 twin rooms (19 m²): one for each couple and one for Tatiana.
candidates.beds: Western beds, 2 × 110 cm wide in each twin.
candidates.lift: Yes, a 9-floor, 180-room hotel (per booking listings).
candidates.private_bath: In every room (bath and toilet), plus an indoor public bath.
candidates.for_fernanda: 24-hour front desk, a lift and a bath in the room. The rooms are small, so ask for a quiet high floor.
candidates.new_year: Not stated. The plans are room only.
candidates.price: Seen on Rakuten Travel on 23 Oct 2026: Twin ¥205,000 for 6 nights for 2 adults, tax included (3+ night plan), with 5 twins left. Four twins come to about ¥820,000, about ¥137,000 a night. Lodging tax is extra.
candidates.cancellation: Not stated in what we could read. Check the plan before booking.
candidates.why: Still bookable for all six nights at a price within our budget, with a front desk that can take the couriered cases.
candidates.watch_out: No kitchen, and it is far from the Okera fire. The Keihan line, which runs all night, stops at Sanjo, about 10 min walk away. The Deluxe Twins are sold out.

candidates.name: Machiya Residence Inn ‘Hanagoromo’ + ‘Hanakagari’ (two houses next door)
candidates.area: 446 Shimozaimokucho, Shimogyo, on the Kiyamachi / Takasegawa side between Shijo and Gojo. Near Kiyomizu-Gojo and Kawaramachi stations. Yasaka Shrine is about 15–20 min on foot (an estimate).
candidates.rooms_for_us: Two neighbouring houses, each for up to 4, booked together for up to 8. Each has 3 bedrooms (6 in all), 1 bath and 2 toilets.
candidates.beds: Mixed. Hanagoromo has 2 single beds and a semi-double (120 cm) in a ground-floor Western room, plus 2 futons. Hanakagari has 2 single beds upstairs and 3 futons. That is 5 beds in all; one couple and Tatiana would be on futons or split up.
candidates.lift: No. Each house has 2 floors with stairs.
candidates.private_bath: In each house: a large bath tub with a rainfall shower.
candidates.for_fernanda: There is a ground-floor bedroom with a semi-double bed in Hanagoromo. It is narrow for two, so Pedro may need the futon room next to it.
candidates.price: Not shown (the rates calendar would not load for us). Check the link.
candidates.cancellation: Standard plan: free up to 22 days before arrival, then 30% (15–21 days), 50% (3–14 days) and 100% (0–2 days). Multi-night and early-booking plans: free up to 61 days before, then 15% (31–60), 30% (15–30), 50% (3–14) and 100% (0–2).
candidates.licence: Hotel/Ryokan Act (旅館業) licence from Kyoto City, as the operator says for all its houses. No number shown.
candidates.why: Licensed for New Year, on the flat side of Kawaramachi, with two kitchens and two baths, and each household gets some privacy.
candidates.watch_out: Self check-in, with staff on the phone 10:00–19:00. Ask who can receive the couriered cases on 30 Dec. Ikyu showed no rooms for our dates at its other houses, so check the official calendar.

candidates.name: The Gion House – Entire House (Old Kyoto)
candidates.area: 563-12 Komatsu-cho, Higashiyama, on a quiet side street south of Kenninji, west of Higashioji (flat). About 8–10 min walk to Yasaka Shrine and Gion-Shijo station (an estimate).
candidates.rooms_for_us: Whole two-level house: 4 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, sleeps 8.
candidates.beds: Mixed. Each floor has one Western bed and one double futon on tatami, and there is a sofa bed downstairs. So 2 couples sleep in beds, the third couple on a double futon, and Tatiana on the sofa bed.
candidates.lift: No. House on 2 floors with stairs.
candidates.private_bath: In the house: a stone bath on the ground floor and a large Western tub upstairs.
candidates.for_fernanda: There is a Western bed and a deep bath on the ground floor, so give the ground-floor bed to Pedro and Fernanda.
candidates.price: Not shown (books through Cloudbeds). Check the link.
candidates.cancellation: Not stated.
candidates.licence: Ask. It is not shown on their page. Make sure it is a Hotel/Ryokan Act (旅館業) licence: a house on a home-share notice in a residential street can only take guests from 15 Jan to 16 Mar.
candidates.why: A real old Gion townhouse, a short flat walk from Yasaka, with two full baths and a ground-floor bed.
candidates.watch_out: Only two real beds for three couples. Confirm it holds a Hotel/Ryokan Act licence, not a home-share notice.

candidates.name: Mitsui Garden Hotel Kyoto Kawaramachi Jokyoji
candidates.area: Teramachi-dori Shijo-sagaru, 1 min walk from Hankyu Kyoto-Kawaramachi station, just south of Shijo. Yasaka Shrine is about 12–15 min flat walk (an estimate).
candidates.rooms_for_us: 3 Standard Twins (24 m²) for the couples, plus a Standard Queen (19 m²) or Wide King for Tatiana.
candidates.beds: Western beds.

candidates.for_fernanda: A short flat walk to Gion and the Okera fire, with a front desk. There is no tub in the room, so ask whether any room has one.
candidates.new_year: Not stated. Room-only and breakfast plans are both offered.

candidates.for_fernanda: Beds, a room of her own with its bathroom, a kitchen and an in-suite washer-dryer, with staff on site.
candidates.price: Seen on Jalan on 23 Oct 2026, 6 nights from 30 Dec, room only: a 2-bedroom suite ¥1,025,730 (2 left) and the Premium ¥1,834,800 (1 left). The 3-bedroom suite did not appear. candidates.name: Machiya Residence Inn ‘Hanatoki’ (Miyagawacho)
candidates.area: 302-12 Daikoku-cho, Higashiyama, in the quiet lanes by Miyagawacho south of Shijo (flat). About 5 min walk from Keihan Kiyomizu-Gojo station. Yasaka Shrine is about 15 min on foot (an estimate).
candidates.rooms_for_us: Whole house, up to 8 guests, but only 2 bedrooms: a Western room with 2 queens (sleeps 4) and a Japanese room with futons (sleeps 3).

candidates.watch_out: Self check-in with no staff on site. Ask about receiving the couriered cases. Too few beds and bedrooms unless some of us are happy on futons.

candidates.name: Rinn Miyagawacho Grande

candidates.rooms_for_us: 3 Standard Twins (19 m²) plus a Standard Double (16 m²) for Tatiana.
candidates.beds: Western beds (2 singles in the twins, a 140 cm bed in the double).
candidates.lift: Not stated; ask.
candidates.private_bath: In every room, with a tub.
candidates.for_fernanda: Perfect location for the Okera night, but the rooms are small and there is no kitchen. Ask about a lift and whether staff are there at night.
candidates.new_year: Huge New Year mark-up: Ikyu showed ¥89,100 for a twin on 30 Dec against ¥14,706 on 5 Jan (room only, 2 people).
candidates.price: Seen on Ikyu on 23 Oct 2026 for 6 nights from 30 Dec, 2 people, room only: Standard Twin ¥631,300 (3 left), Standard Double ¥622,900. Three twins plus a double come to about ¥2.5 million, about ¥420,000 a night.
candidates.cancellation: Not stated.
candidates.why: One of the few hotels right in our area with twins still free for all six nights.
candidates.watch_out: Very poor value over New Year. Check-in is 16:00–21:00; ask whether the front desk is staffed and whether it will accept the couriered cases.

candidates.name: Machiya Residence Inn ‘Ruikou’
candidates.area: 60-2 Nishishinyashiki Chudojicho, Shimogyo, west of Kyoto Station near Nishi Honganji (station-area fallback). Far from Gion: about 15 min by taxi to Yasaka Shrine (an estimate).
candidates.rooms_for_us: Main house plus a separate garden cottage, up to 9 guests, 2 bathrooms.
candidates.beds: Mixed. 3 double beds in all (1 in the main house upstairs, 2 in the cottage) plus 4 futons in two tatami rooms. All three couples get a bed, and Tatiana sleeps on a futon.
candidates.lift: No. The main house has bedrooms upstairs; the page doesn't say which floor the cottage beds are on.
candidates.private_bath: In the house: each building has its own full bathroom with a tub.
candidates.for_fernanda: The cottage with 2 double beds and its own heated bathroom could be Pedro and Fernanda's. Ask whether its beds are on the ground floor.
candidates.price: Not shown. Check the link.
candidates.cancellation: Same as the other Machiya Residence Inn houses: free up to 22 days before (standard plan) or 61 days before (early-booking and multi-night plans).
candidates.licence: Hotel/Ryokan Act (旅館業) licence from Kyoto City, as the operator says for all its houses. No number shown.
candidates.why: The most beds of any licensed townhouse we found, with two baths. A fallback if nothing near Gion works.
candidates.watch_out: You need a taxi to the Okera fire, and taxis are scarce on New Year's Eve. Self check-in with no staff on site.

enquiry.en:
Dear [PLACE] team,

We are a group of 7 adults (three couples and one person on her own) hoping to stay with you from 30 December 2026 to 5 January 2027 (6 nights, checking out on 5 January). Could you please tell us whether you have space for us, and the total price including any New Year surcharge?

A few questions that matter for us:
1. Beds: we would like a real bed for everyone (not only futons), ideally three rooms for the couples and one for our single friend. Could you tell us how many separate bedrooms there are and what beds are in each?
2. One of us will be about 30 weeks pregnant. Is there a bedroom with beds on the ground floor, or a lift? Is the bathroom with a bath tub on the same floor?
3. Do the rooms (or the house) have their own bathroom with a tub, plus heating and a washing machine?
4. Our large suitcases will be sent by courier (Yamato) and should arrive on 30 December. Can you receive them before we check in? If so, what name and address should we use? If there is no staff on site, where can they be delivered?
5. New Year: will your front desk or contact staff be available from 31 December to 3 January? Do you offer any New Year meals, and do you know which shops or restaurants nearby stay open on 1–3 January?
6. Could you please confirm your licence type (Hotel/Ryokan Act) and your cancellation policy for these dates?

Thank you very much for your help. We look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards,
Pedro
enquiry.ja:
[PLACE] ご担当者様

突然のご連絡失礼いたします。2026年12月30日から2027年1月5日まで（6泊、1月5日チェックアウト）、大人7名（夫婦3組と女性1名）での宿泊を検討しております。上記日程で空きがございますでしょうか。年末年始の特別料金を含めた合計金額もお知らせいただけますと幸いです。

あわせて、以下の点についてお伺いできますでしょうか。
1. 寝具について：全員分ベッドを希望しております（布団のみではなく）。できれば夫婦用に3部屋、女性1名用に1部屋あると助かります。寝室の数と、各部屋のベッドの種類・台数を教えていただけますか。
2. 1名が妊娠30週前後になります。1階にベッドのある寝室、またはエレベーターはございますか。また、浴槽のある浴室は同じ階にございますか。
3. 各部屋（または建物内）に浴槽付きの専用バスルーム、暖房、洗濯機はございますか。
4. 大きなスーツケースを宅配便（ヤマト運輸）で送り、12月30日に到着する予定です。チェックイン前にお受け取りいただくことは可能でしょうか。可能な場合、宛名と住所の書き方を教えてください。現地にスタッフの方がいらっしゃらない場合は、どちらへ送ればよろしいでしょうか。
5. 年末年始について：12月31日から1月3日の間も、フロントまたは連絡窓口は対応されていますか。お正月のお食事のご用意はございますか。また、1月1日〜3日に近くで営業しているお店やスーパーをご存じでしたら教えてください。
6. 営業許可の種別（旅館業法による許可かどうか）と、この日程のキャンセル規定をご確認いただけますでしょうか。

お忙しいところ恐縮ですが、どうぞよろしくお願い申し上げます。

kawaguchiko.summary: Lots of hotels here have rooms that see Fuji, but rooms with real beds and a Fuji view for seven people cost about ¥210,000–300,000 a night with meals. That is well over our budget of ¥110,000–150,000. Only Hotel Regina (all rooms face Fuji, about ¥122,000 room only) and Breeze Bay (east shore, but Fuji not promised) fit the budget. The best bet you can book now is La Vista Fuji Kawaguchiko on the north shore: Rakuten still had 4+ Fuji-view twins with their own view bath for our two nights, and its early-booking dinner plan needs booking by about 6 Nov 2026. Ubuya on the east shore is the best match on paper, but Rakuten showed no rooms for 5 or 6 Jan, so ask them directly today.

candidates.name: La Vista Fuji Kawaguchiko (Kyoritsu Resort)
candidates.area: North shore (Kawaguchi 2395), across the lake from Fuji. About 10–15 min by the hotel's free shuttle from Kawaguchiko station. Not in our picked east-shore area.
candidates.rooms_for_us: 4 rooms: 3 'La Vista Twin' (41 m², 3rd–7th floor, Fuji-view bath inside the room) for the couples, plus 1 Rose Double or La Vista Double for Tatiana (the price is per room, so a single pays the same as a couple). Rakuten showed 4 La Vista Twins, 2 Rose Twins, 3 Rose Doubles and 2 La Vista Doubles left.
candidates.beds: Western beds. Twin rooms have 2 beds; Double rooms have 1 double bed.
candidates.lift: Not stated, but the rooms are spread over 7 floors, so a lift is almost certain. Ask them to confirm.
candidates.private_bath: In every room. The Fuji-view rooms have a 'view bath': on the terrace in the Rose rooms and on the balcony in La Vista Doubles, and indoors in La Vista Twins. The breakfast plan also includes free private family baths.
candidates.for_fernanda: Good: real beds, a private bath with a Fuji view, a lift-served building and a shuttle. Ask for a La Vista Twin, which has an indoor bath. The Rose Twin's bath is outside on the terrace and has no shower booth.
candidates.new_year: Not stated. 5–7 Jan is after the holidays, and the prices looked like normal weekday rates.
candidates.price: Rakuten, seen 23 Oct 2026 for 5–7 Jan, 2 adults, total for both nights: Rose Twin (29 m², terrace open-air Fuji-view bath) ¥106,480 with breakfast. La Vista Twin ¥115,520 room only, ¥134,200 with breakfast, or ¥135,960 with dinner and breakfast on the 'Sakiraku 60' plan (book at least 60 days ahead). One adult pays about the same per room. Rough group total: about ¥215,000 a night with breakfast, or about ¥270,000 a night with dinner too.
candidates.cancellation: Rakuten house rule: free until 8 days before; 10% from 7 days; 20% from 4 days; 50% from 2 days; 80% on the day. Some plans have their own rules.
candidates.why: Confirmed availability for our exact nights, with real beds, a private Fuji-view bath in every room, a shuttle, and dinner on site so no one needs to go out at night.
candidates.watch_out: It's on the north shore, not the east shore, and over budget. The cheaper 'Sakiraku 60' dinner plan needs booking by about 6 Nov 2026. The shuttle must be booked and runs from the station at 14:00, 15:00, 16:00, 17:00 and 18:00.

candidates.name: Fujikawaguchiko Onsen Ubuya (うぶや)
candidates.area: East shore, Asakawa 10, right on the lake. This is our picked area. About 5–10 min by car from Kawaguchiko station.
candidates.rooms_for_us: Every room faces Fuji across the lake. The best fit is 3 or 4 'Japanese-style room with 2 Western beds' (46 m²), or one 'Standard with private open-air bath' (59 m², Japanese room plus a twin bedroom) for Pedro & Fernanda. Rakuten plans take 2–4 people per room, so Tatiana would have to pay for a 2-person room or share.
candidates.beds: Western twin beds (200 × 120 cm) in every room type, including the Japanese-style rooms, according to the official room page.
candidates.lift: Not stated (51 rooms over 5 floors; they lend 3 wheelchairs). Ask them to confirm.
candidates.private_bath: Every room has its own bathroom. The 'with private open-air bath' rooms (Standard 59 m² and up) have an open-air tub on the balcony, filled with heated tap water, not hot-spring water. There is no bookable private bath; the public baths can't be reserved.
candidates.for_fernanda: Very good on paper: beds in every room, a Fuji view from bed, and a shuttle. Book her a 'Standard with private open-air bath' room, and ask about the lift. Spa treatments are not offered to pregnant guests.
candidates.new_year: Not stated. The Rakuten plans run until 31 Mar 2027.

enquiry.en:
Dear [PLACE],

We would like to stay for 2 nights, checking in on Tuesday 5 January 2027 and checking out on Thursday 7 January 2027. We are 7 adults: three couples and one woman travelling alone, so we would need 4 rooms (3 twin rooms and 1 room for one person).

One of us will be about 30 weeks pregnant, and two of us are older, so could you please tell us:
1. Which room types have a view of Mt Fuji (not only of the lake), and are there 4 of them free for these dates?
2. Do these rooms have Western beds (not futons)?
3. Is there a lift to all guest floors, and are there any steps on the way to the rooms?
4. Does each room have its own bath or shower? Is there a private bath we can book?
5. Can we book dinner and breakfast for both nights? Can the 7 of us eat at one table, and what time does dinner start?
6. We will arrive by bus at Kawaguchiko station in the afternoon of 5 January. Do you offer a pick-up, and can you take us back to the station on the morning of 7 January for the Fuji Excursion train?
7. Are there any special New Year prices or rules for these dates?
8. What is your cancellation policy?

Thank you very much. We look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards,
Pedro
enquiry.ja:
[PLACE] ご担当者様

突然のご連絡失礼いたします。2027年1月5日（火）チェックイン、1月7日（木）チェックアウトの2泊で宿泊を希望しております。大人7名（夫婦3組と女性1名）で、ツインルーム3室と1名利用のお部屋1室、計4室をお願いしたいと考えております。

同行者に妊娠30週前後の者と年配の者がおりますため、以下の点を教えていただけますでしょうか。
1. 富士山が見えるお部屋（湖だけでなく富士山が見えるお部屋）はどのタイプでしょうか。上記の日程で4室の空きはございますか。
2. そのお部屋は布団ではなくベッドでしょうか。
3. 客室階までエレベーターはございますか。お部屋までの間に階段や段差はございますか。
4. 各客室にお風呂またはシャワーはございますか。また、予約制の貸切風呂はございますか。
5. 2泊とも夕食・朝食付きで予約できますか。7名で同じテーブルで食事できますか。夕食の開始時間も教えてください。
6. 1月5日の午後にバスで河口湖駅に到着予定です。駅からの送迎はございますか。また、1月7日の朝、富士回遊号に乗るため駅までお送りいただけますか。
7. この日程について、年末年始の特別料金や決まりはございますか。
8. キャンセル規定を教えてください。

お忙しいところ恐れ入りますが、どうぞよろしくお願いいたします。

ペドロ

tokyo:2.summary: There are plenty of good hotels within a few minutes' flat walk of Kabuki-za, but Ginza is not cheap on a Thursday and Friday in early January. Three twins plus a room for Tatiana comes to about ¥140,000–165,000 a night room-only at the Mitsui Garden hotels, Tokyu Stay and Hotel Keihan, and about ¥200,000 or more at Millennium (flexible rate) and the Royal Park. The best bet is Mitsui Garden Hotel Ginza-gochome, one minute from Higashi-Ginza and right behind Kabuki-za. Millennium Mitsui Garden, across the street from the theatre, is the slightly nicer choice if you pay a little more. Some rooms are already selling out: The Gate Hotel showed no rooms on Rakuten for these nights, Hyatt Centric had 3 twins left at about ¥135,000 per room per night, and the larger corner rooms show only 1–4 left.

enquiry.en:
Dear [PLACE],

We would like to stay with you for 2 nights, from Thursday 7 January to Saturday 9 January 2027. We are 7 adults: three couples and one woman travelling on her own. We would like 3 twin rooms and 1 single or queen room, ideally on the same quiet floor, close to each other and near the lift. Connecting rooms would be wonderful if you have them.

Could you please help us with these questions?
1. Do the twin rooms have Western beds, and do they have a bathtub or a shower only? One of us will be about 31 weeks pregnant, so a quiet room and an easy bathroom matter to us.
2. Our large suitcases will be sent to you by courier (Yamato) from Kyoto on 4 January and should arrive on 5 January, before we check in. Can you receive and hold them for us? What name and dates should we write on the labels?
3. We will arrive in the afternoon of 7 January. If our rooms are not ready, can we leave our bags with you?
4. On the morning of 9 January we fly home from Haneda. Can you book a large taxi or van for 7 people with luggage, and what would it cost? Is a late check-out possible?
5. What is your cancellation policy for this booking?

Thank you very much. We look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards,
Pedro
enquiry.ja:
[PLACE] ご担当者様

2027年1月7日（木）から1月9日（土）までの2泊で、宿泊を検討しております。大人7名（夫婦3組と女性1名）で、ツイン3室とシングルまたはクイーン1室を希望しております。できれば静かな同じフロアで、お部屋同士が近く、エレベーターに近いお部屋ですと助かります。コネクティングルームがございましたら、ぜひお願いしたいです。

以下の点についてお教えいただけますでしょうか。
1. ツインのお部屋はベッドでしょうか。また、バスタブ付きでしょうか、シャワーのみでしょうか。同行者の1名が妊娠31週ほどのため、静かなお部屋と使いやすい浴室を希望しております。
2. 大きなスーツケースを1月4日に京都から宅配便（ヤマト運輸）でお送りし、チェックイン前の1月5日に到着する予定です。お預かりいただけますでしょうか。伝票にはどのようにお名前と宿泊日を記入すればよろしいでしょうか。
3. 1月7日は午後に到着予定です。お部屋の準備ができていない場合、荷物をお預けすることは可能でしょうか。
4. 1月9日の朝、羽田空港から帰国いたします。7名と荷物が乗れるジャンボタクシーまたはワゴン車の手配をお願いできますでしょうか。料金の目安も教えていただけますと幸いです。また、レイトチェックアウトは可能でしょうか。
5. 今回のご予約のキャンセル規定についても教えてください。

お手数をおかけいたしますが、どうぞよろしくお願いいたします。

ペドロ
